summary: Remote agent with WebSocket-driven file access and command execution, persisted via system-level autostart
details: Package is a persistent agent that opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded server (wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com, with local/LAN alternates) and accepts remote messages on channels including system, agent, session, and file to read, write, and search files in the user's working directory, spawn the Claude CLI with permission-bypass flags, and trigger self-update by stopping the daemon, running npm install, and restarting. The 'agenthub install' subcommand registers Windows Task Scheduler, Linux systemd, and macOS launchd/LaunchDaemon persistence (evidenced by daemon.vbs, network.target/multi-user.target strings, and a PropertyList plist writer) so the WebSocket-driven executor auto-starts at boot, in several code paths as SYSTEM/root. Whoever controls the WebSocket server can read and modify files on any paired host and run arbitrary shell/CLI commands there; when persistence is installed with admin/root, that control survives reboot at elevated privilege. The 'install' step does not run automatically on npm install (no lifecycle hooks are declared) — it fires when the user runs the CLI — but once run the remote-control surface is continuous.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
